chunks.heading: Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Programming
chunks.text:
Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Programming
Covers basic structured programming concepts, including data types and operators, as well as Object-Oriented Programming concepts such as objects, classes, inheritance, and polymorphism.

chunks.heading: Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Data Structures and Algorithms
chunks.text:
Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Data Structures and Algorithms
Covers stacks, queues, lists, hash tables, and sorting and searching algorithms.

chunks.heading: Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Database Manage nt Systems
chunks.text:
Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Database Manage nt Systems
Covers relational database concepts, ER diagrams, normalization, and transactions.

chunks.heading: Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Software Engineering
chunks.text:
Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Software Engineering
Covers software process models, planning and scheduling, and testing.

chunks.heading: Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Artificial Intelligence
chunks.text:
Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Artificial Intelligence
Covers problem solving through search, logic, and current trends in AI.

chunks.heading: Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Computer Networks
chunks.text:
Admission Test Syllabus for MTech in AI > Computer Networks
Covers the basics of computer networks, TCP/IP, the physical layer, the network layer, the data link layer, and concepts of IP addressing.
